meta: A check that your store tracking is accurate, with fixes for purchases, events and ad pixels. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Analytics review for accurate store numbers
overview: Wrong numbers lead to wrong decisions, so we check that your tracking records what really happens. We test purchases, add to cart, checkout steps and ad pixels against real orders, looking for double counting, missing sales and traffic that is mislabelled. You get a simple report of what is correct and what is not, and we repair the issues we can fix inside your own accounts.

faq: Do I need to give you my analytics login?
No. You add us as a user to your analytics, tag manager and ad accounts with the access level you choose. We never ask for your password.
What if my numbers do not match my orders?
That is common. We compare each tracked sale with real orders, find where the gap starts, such as a duplicate tag or blocked page, and fix it or explain the cause.
Will you set up new tracking from nothing?
Yes, at the Standard level and above we add missing core events. If you have no analytics at all, we set up the basics and keep the account in your name.
